description: This PHP file defines a function 'additionalDetailsContact' for rendering detailed contact information in a specific HTML format, including address, phone numbers, modification date, and description, and pulls module language strings dynamically.

methods.name: additionalDetailsContact
methods.description: Generates an HTML-formatted string with detailed information about a contact, including address, phone, mod strings, and other metadata, returning an array with the formatted string and view/edit links.
